Analytical Protocol - Inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry: (Samples were analyzed for Al, Fe, and trace elements (Li, V, Cr, Mn, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn, As, Ag, Cd, Pb) on an 8800 triple quadrupole ICP-MS (Agilent Technologies) using O2 or H2 as a reaction gas in MS/MS mode, depending on the element. Accuracy and precision of the method were determined using the certified reference materials MESS-4 (n = 3) and BCR-277R (n = 3), with all recoveries between 82 and 107 %.)
